title: Seasonal Service Rule for Electric Service by Rate Schedule: Seasonal Idle and Restore
content:
A seasonal idle de-energizes the meter of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account for the off season without closing the account.

### Seasonal idle

- A seasonal idle may be ordered only on a schedule that allows a seasonal idle, only on an active account, and only on the member's confirmed service order.
- An account under a disconnect notice cannot be idled.
- While idle the meter is de-energized; the facility charge continues only where the schedule continues the facility charge during idle months.

### Restore

- The former clause stating that a restore is billed the schedule's seasonal restore fee is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current seasonal restore fee basis. The seasonal restore fee figure itself remains as stated on the seasonal service terms.
- When the restore is ordered before the schedule's minimum idle period, in calendar months, has passed since the idle date, the facility charges of the idle periods that did not bill are back-billed as facility charge lines, in addition to the restore fee.

### Early restore — hypothetical Schedule IR pivot

A Schedule IR account (minimum idle period 4 calendar months; no facility charge during idle months) idled on October 15 (hypothetical) and restored on January 20 has not completed 4 calendar months since the idle date. The facility charges of the idle periods that did not bill are back-billed as facility charge lines, in addition to the restore fee. Restored on February 20 instead, the account has passed 4 calendar months and no facility charge is back-billed.

A Schedule RS cabin keeps billing its facility charge while idle, so an early restore on Schedule RS finds no unbilled facility periods to back-bill.

### Eligibility at a glance

| Account (hypothetical) | Seasonal idle may be ordered |
|---|---|
| Active Schedule RS cabin, member's confirmed order | Yes |
| Active Schedule IR pivot, member's confirmed order | Yes |
| Schedule RS cabin under a disconnect notice | No |
| Active Schedule R home | No — the schedule allows no seasonal idle |
| Active Schedule IR pivot, no confirmed order from the member | No |
